name: inventory-dashboard
description: MERN admin dashboard: products, stock and orders with roles, MongoDB transactions that never oversell, live demo, 43 tests

paragraphs: A MERN admin panel for a small shop: products, stock, orders and a sales dashboard, with login and two roles. Built the way I build client tools: business rules enforced on the server, typed end to end, and tested against a real MongoDB.
Live demo: (runs in your browser with sample data; sign in with one click as admin or staff)
features: Login and roles: JWT auth. admin manages products; staff takes orders and adjusts stock. Wrong password and unknown email get the same answer.

Products: search, category filter, low-stock filter, sorting, paging; create and edit with field-level validation errors; SKUs unique regardless of case; a product that appears in orders cannot be deleted.
Stock adjustments: with a reason, recorded in a stock movement log, never below zero.

Orders: multi-line orders with live totals, prices copied at order time, sequential order numbers (SO-1001), ship and cancel (cancel returns the stock), filters by status, text and date range, CSV export with proper…
Dashboard: revenue and orders for the last 30 days, revenue by day chart, top products, low-stock list.
